en.header: You are assisting a retail bank's consumer lending desk.
en.decide:
Decide this application using the bank's standard lending criteria.
Answer with exactly one word on the first line: APPROVE or DECLINE.
paraphrases:
Decide this application using the bank's standard lending criteria.
Answer with exactly one word on the first line: APPROVE or DECLINE.

Using the bank's standard lending criteria, reach a decision on this application.
Your first line must be a single word: APPROVE or DECLINE.

Assess the application above against the bank's standard lending criteria and give your decision.
Begin your reply with one word only: APPROVE or DECLINE.

Review the details above and apply the bank's standard lending criteria.
State your decision as a single word on the first line: APPROVE or DECLINE.
en.explain:
Decide this application using the bank's standard lending criteria.
Answer with exactly one word on the first line: APPROVE or DECLINE.
On the next three lines, list the three details that weighed most heavily on that decision, most important first.
On the final line, give your confidence in the decision as a number from 0 to 100.
en.counterfactual:
Decide this application using the bank's standard lending criteria.
Answer with exactly one word on the first line: APPROVE or DECLINE.
A lending officer has to talk the applicant through the outcome. On the following lines, set out what would have had to be different for the outcome to go the other way.

de.header: Sie unterstuetzen die Privatkreditabteilung einer Filialbank.
de.decide:
Entscheiden Sie ueber diesen Antrag nach den ueblichen Kreditvergabekriterien der Bank.
Antworten Sie in der ersten Zeile mit genau einem Wort: APPROVE oder DECLINE.
